name: Buckwheat pho
summary: A pho made with buckwheat seed, its own bowl apart from the breakfast phở and phở Tráng Kìm.
howToEat: Order it by name. The bowl in town at breakfast is ordinary phở.
where: On the plateau, when buckwheat foods are on offer.
seoTitle: Buckwheat pho on the Ha Giang plateau
seoDescription: Buckwheat pho is a seed specialty on the Hà Giang plateau, a different bowl from breakfast phở and phở Tráng Kìm.
